rationale: C115 flags basis_spread values stored outside the expected percentage range. The raw SOI rows show spread terms as S + 475 and S + 275, which are basis-point notation and correspond to 4.75% and 2.75%, while the extracted values are 475.0 and 275.0. The row context also shows normal all-in interest rates of 9.99% and 8.18%, confirming the spread terms were not percentage-rate values.
